integrity: The all-length proof is self-contained. Finite direct-rotation tests were run from the included standard-library script and independently compare exact input classes and explicit pairings.
scientific_limitations: Only the fixed-composition binary two-one layer; the observation consists of ordinary and Lyndon-conjugate Parikh matrices. Full text of a related 2021 journal version was inaccessible; independent expert validation has not been performed.
title: Parity rigidity in two-marker Lyndon–Parikh reconstruction
